title: PR8553 Staging Backup Broker host discovery environment impact

phases.objective: Verify exact Staging host and network inventory can be observed without creating any DBA principal, grant, service, signature, or Production mutation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Inspect host and Docker topology using read-only commands, feed only redacted observations to the fail-closed assessor.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Topological discovery can pass, but independent Broker attestation and all database privileges remain blocked.
steps: Verify exact source SHA, expected device name, five Staging container health states and Docker network/subnet.
Check runtime-db has no published host port.
Check explicitly named Staging-only Windows Broker service and Docker sidecar candidates without modifying any resource.
Return a redacted read-only report and nonzero exit code even when the topology is observed.
Reject wrong SHA, wrong device or network, published database port and unhealthy container.
assertions: Production effects, SQL, grants, credential reads and service installation are absent.
Owner operation Ed25519 approval cannot be inferred from source or topology observations.
Host discovery never outputs broker_operationally_certified=true or db_admin_operation_authorized=true.
Shared Local Connector paths are explicitly reviewed for both environment targets; Production mutation remains false.
Live Staging certification is required before treating the feature as operational.
